svg.aria-label: Two-by-two grid. Rows: whether the agent's memory reads the world. Columns: whether its actions read the memory. Only when both are true can the world's fuel fall below the floor, and then by at most the information the actions use. In the other three cells the floor holds: knowledge left unused, a memory blind to the world, or no knowledge at all.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
